notes.title: Bugs fixed and new feature
notes.content:
Hello everyone!  

Once again, thank you so much to everyone who has purchased the game, I hope you're enjoying it! Remember, if you have any questions or suggestions, feel free to message me, and I'll respond as soon as I can!  

I've fixed a series of bugs that a very kind user reported to me. Here's the list:  

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Tenshi and Koneko's images to remain on screen after giving them a gift. That was my mistake, sorry about that.  
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented you from giving Koneko a gift that day if you had previously given one to Tenshi. The way the game works is that when you give a girl a gift, a specific switch is activated for her, and while it's on, you can't give her another gift. At the end of the day, it turns off. Well, I had accidentally made Koneko’s switch the same as Tenshi’s. Now, each one has their own switch—problem solved.  
[*] Fixed a bug that caused an interface to appear by accident at the end of the erotic kissing scene between Elith and Tenshi. I’ve updated the kissing scene so that doesn’t happen anymore.  
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed you to walk on top of the table in the Great Hall, which also caused the screen to flicker red. A small issue with a quick fix—sorry about that.  
[*] Fixed a minor spelling mistake in Lila’s dialogue.  
[*] Added a new option in the pause menu called **"Exit Game"**, allowing you to close the game without having to manually close the window.  
[*] Added Tenshi and Koneko’s stats—you can check them in Elith’s quarters. Sorry, I forgot to add them before.  
[/list]

That’s all for this update! I’ll be releasing more updates soon, adding more sexual scenes.  

Have a great day!

notes.title: Achievements added
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

First of all, thank you so much to everyone who has purchased the game so far, I hope you're enjoying it. If you have any feedback for me, I'd be happy to hear it!

I've just added 30 achievements in total to the game, although I don't rule out adding more in the future.

I'm sorry I didn't add achievements to the game on launch day, unfortunately it's something that took me a lot of time and effort because it turned out to be a lot harder than I expected. But in theory, it's done now and they should all work perfectly.

I'll continue to update the game with more content in the near future.

Have a great day!
